content:
amanda: kicked off canary->100% for v3.4.1 at 2026-03-21T14:00Z. doing a quick post-deploy smoke: synthetic probes + KV warmup. noticed a short p95 spike in eu during canary, can we validate what happened?

deploy-bot: deploy complete: rollout v3.4.1 -> 100% (canary window passed). checks: prefill=ok, kv-warmup=started, alerts=0 critical. running post-deploy synth sweep.

raj: saw the p95 bump around 14:02. logs show a tokenizer latency spike on the embed route. sample metric: `tokenizer_latency_us` jumped 12000 -> baseline ~45. link to quick grafana: https://grafana.redwood/s/dash?k=embed

jen: starting targeted synthetic sweep now (1000 samples across eu, usw2, apac3). will post summary in ~5m.

mike: noticed intermittent 429s hitting modelvariant=quant2 at ~14:03. pattern looks like pool exhaustion. snippet from logs: `429 rate-limited` + `quant2_pool_exhausted`. routing fallback to quant1 triggered.

amanda: ok — pin canary for 10m while we triage. if eu p95 stays >5x baseline we consider rollback. otherwise we keep and update notes. do not do full rollback immediately; we need more data. @sre-oncall please monitor. :eyes:

deploy-bot: probe-results: eu p95=220ms (baseline 40ms) between 14:01-14:04, usw2 p95 stable. synthetic failure rate=0.3% (threshold=0.1%). creating alert in #eng-oncall.

sre-jen: digging in. KV warmup on eu hosts is stuck ~60% because prefill tasks are serializing on host startup. hypothesis: prefill parallelism default (4) insufficient under current pod churn. plan: increase prefill parallelism to 12 for eu and re-run warmup. rolling patch prepping.

raj: can someone grep for `model_variant: quant2` around 14:02-14:04? I want the concurrent errors.

mike: grep output: found `quant2_pool_exhausted` at 2026-03-21T14:03:12 (x3), followed by `backend-retry` logs and then `fallback->quant1`. looks transient.

amanda: decision: apply the prefill parallelism bump in eu, hold full release for 30m. do NOT rollback yet since fallback preserved user requests. I'll update the release notes with the incident and mitigation.

jen: post-fix synth sweep complete: eu p95 back to 45ms, synthetic failure rate 0.02%. running a 5m steady-state run now to confirm.

raj: verified no new `quant2_pool_exhausted` after the restart. logs show `quant2_pool_recover` at 2026-03-21T14:11:08. looks clear.

deploy-bot: canary_pin_released: pin removed, rollout marked stable. draft_release_notes: "v3.4.1: tokenizer routing adjustments, safer quant2->quant1 fallback, temporary increase to eu prefill parallelism; monitoring thresholds tuned."

amanda: followups: 1) create ticket to revisit quant2 pool sizing and autoscaler rule, 2) add a synthetic test that exercises staggered prefill on eu in CI, 3) include short-prompts tokenizer eval in post-release checks. I'll post final release notes to #release-notes after review. :thumbsup:

mike: created INF-4721 for autoscaler/pool sizing, assigned to infra.

raj: added an eval prompt set (short prompt tokenizer) to catch regressions. PR linked in the release notes draft.

sre-jen: will add a dashboard panel for prefill progress per host.

amanda: thanks all — closing thread unless something else pops up. :white_check_mark:
